issues.title: Metering pipeline backpressure during burst events
issues.description: Under heavy burst load (>40k req/min) the metering aggregator falls behind by 8-12 minutes before catching up. Downstream usage records reflect delayed timestamps. Affects accuracy of real-time usage dashboards and overage alerting. Root cause: single-threaded flush to Postgres; need async batch writer.

issues.title: Stripe webhook: charge.succeeded dedup race condition
issues.description: Intermittent duplicate usage records when Stripe retries a charge.succeeded event within 200ms of the first delivery. Idempotency check uses Redis SET NX with a 100ms TTL which is too short. Increase TTL to 30s and add a DB-level unique constraint on (stripe_charge_id, event_type).

issues.title: K8s autoscaler: CPU target too conservative in us-east-2
issues.description: HPA target CPU utilisation set at 45% across all regions. us-east-2 consistently hovers at 40-43% during business hours, causing frequent unnecessary scale-up events and ~12% excess node cost. Raise target to 65% for us-east-2; keep 45% for us-west-2 (higher variance). Update Terraform module variable.

issues.title: Customer dashboard P99 latency regression after v2.14 deploy
issues.description: Post-v2.14 deploy on 2026-06-02 the /api/v2/usage/summary endpoint P99 jumped from 420ms to 1.1s. Flame graph shows N+1 query on account_settings join introduced in the new contract-tier filter. Fix: eager-load account_settings in the usage query resolver.

issues.title: Onboarding: welcome email sequence delayed >3h for EU signups
issues.description: New accounts created in eu-west-1 are not receiving the welcome email within the 30-minute SLA. Investigation shows the SQS queue consumer in eu-west-1 is polling the US-east SES endpoint due to a misconfigured ENV var (SES_REGION=us-east-1 hardcoded in prod eu-west-1 task definition). Fix ENV var and redeploy.

issues.title: Terraform state lock not released after failed apply in prod
issues.description: A failed terraform apply on 2026-06-10 (ECS task def update, exit code 1 on plan validation) left the S3-backed state lock held. Subsequent applies by other engineers blocked for ~40min until lock was force-released. Need to implement automatic lock TTL via DynamoDB conditional expression and alert on locks held >10min.
